infrastructure_and_technology_stack.cloud_provider: Amazon Web Services (AWS) - US regions, Multi-AZ deployment
infrastructure_and_technology_stack.compute_and_application: VPC isolated private subnets, Application Load Balancers (ALB) with TLS termination, backend application containers/APIs
infrastructure_and_technology_stack.data_storage_and_encryption: AWS RDS / S3 / DynamoDB, encrypted at rest using AES-256, TLS 1.2+ in transit
infrastructure_and_technology_stack.network_security: CDN + WAF (DDoS filtering, TLS termination), Security Groups enforcing tier isolation (Public Subnet -> Application Tier -> Data Tier)
infrastructure_and_technology_stack.remote_admin_access: VPN Gateway (enforces MFA, IP allow-list) -> Bastion Host (audited, ephemeral SSH access) -> Production VPC
infrastructure_and_technology_stack.logging_and_monitoring: Cloud-native AWS CloudWatch + S3 log archival (~1 year retention). SIEM centralized logging is a planned roadmap improvement.
infrastructure_and_technology_stack.on_premise_footprint: Contradiction exists: Policy says cloud-only with no on-prem data centers, but Asset Inventory lists Dell PowerEdge R740 (on-prem backup) in HQ server room and Cisco Meraki MX67 Firewall in office.
infrastructure_and_technology_stack.identity_and_collaboration: Google Workspace (enforces MFA), GitHub (PR peer reviews, branch protection), Slack / Teams for internal communications

contradictions_and_investigation_playboo.description: Information Security Policy explicitly claims zero on-premises servers, but Asset Inventory lists an active on-prem backup server and firewall.
contradictions_and_investigation_playboo.evidence_a: Information Security Policy v1.0 (Sec 8, Sec 12): 'The company operates no on-premises servers or data centers... the company owns no data centers or server rooms. Physical office presence is limited to a co-working facility.'
contradictions_and_investigation_playboo.evidence_b: Asset Inventory Regodit (Rows 10, 13): 'SN-100239 | Server | Dell PowerEdge R740 (on-prem backup) | In Use | Located in HQ server room' and 'SN-100242 | Cisco Meraki MX67 Firewall | In Use | Primary office firewall/router'
contradictions_and_investigation_playboo.agent_guidance: DO NOT answer 'Yes, we are 100% cloud-only' or 'No, we have on-prem servers' without investigating. Identify the conflict: Policies specify cloud-native multi-AZ AWS architecture, yet internal asset inventory records an on-premise Dell PowerEdge backup server in an HQ server room. Ask the user/stakeholder to clarify whether the on-prem server is a legacy asset, a testing sandbox, or an active operational backup.

contradictions_and_investigation_playboo.description: Network architecture diagrams show an active SIEM for centralized logging, but the formal Information Security Policy states no dedicated SIEM exists.
contradictions_and_investigation_playboo.evidence_a: Network Architecture Diagrams (Figure 2) & admin-access-logging-diagram.png: Shows 'Centralized logging: SIEM, alerting, retention' fed directly from Production environment.
contradictions_and_investigation_playboo.evidence_b: Information Security Policy v1.0 (Sec 11): 'The company does not currently operate a dedicated SIEM; centralized log analytics is a planned improvement. Cloud-native monitoring is used across the company's cloud providers. Application logs are rotated on the host and shipped to object storage for retention.'
contradictions_and_investigation_playboo.evidence_c: Network Architecture Diagrams PDF (Page 2 Disclaimer): 'Note: these are illustrative templates. For an actual SOC 2 engagement, the diagram must match the real configuration...'
contradictions_and_investigation_playboo.agent_guidance: Answer that logging is centralized via cloud-native AWS tools (CloudWatch, S3 object storage with ~1-year retention), while dedicated SIEM analytics is a planned improvement. Point out that the architecture diagram is an illustrative reference template.

contradictions_and_investigation_playboo.description: Company uses Regodit and Solsphere AI Inc interchangeably across legal documents, policies, and questionnaire.
contradictions_and_investigation_playboo.evidence_a: Form W-9 & BCP/DR Plan: 'Solsphere AI Inc', Dover, Delaware 19901, C Corporation.
contradictions_and_investigation_playboo.evidence_b: Employment Contract 01: 'Solsphere AI Inc (dba Regodit, having its registered office at Dover, Delaware...)'
contradictions_and_investigation_playboo.evidence_c: Questionnaire Tab 'Vendor Security Responses' Cell B45: 'Vendor Name as Listed on W-9:'
contradictions_and_investigation_playboo.agent_guidance: Provide 'Solsphere AI Inc (dba Regodit)'. Explain that Solsphere AI Inc is the legal corporate entity incorporated in Delaware, while Regodit is the commercial trade name (dba). For W-9 line 1, the verified legal name is Solsphere AI Inc.

contradictions_and_investigation_playboo.description: Offboarding policy requires immediate access revocation, but access review records show contractor retained AWS Admin credentials after decommissioning.
contradictions_and_investigation_playboo.evidence_a: HR Policy v1.0 & Asset Inventory: Contractor M. Delgado retired on 08/30/2026; laptop SN-100240 wiped and decommissioned per offboarding checklist.
contradictions_and_investigation_playboo.evidence_b: Access Review Records (09/04/2026): M. Delgado still listed with active AWS Production Console Admin role; flagged as 'Access Justified: N | Action needed: Revoke access' 5 days after hardware offboarding.
contradictions_and_investigation_playboo.agent_guidance: Acknowledge the formal offboarding procedure exists (hardware wipe, checklist execution), but highlight that operational access review discovered a 5-day lag: contractor M. Delgado retained AWS cloud console access after hardware wipe, and the access review flagged 'Action needed: Revoke access' on 09/04/2026. Because an action request does not prove completion, the analyst must ask the user whether AWS console access was actually revoked.

contradictions_and_investigation_playboo.description: The SOC 2 Type II report contains two contradictory company background statements.
contradictions_and_investigation_playboo.evidence_a: SOC 2 Report Section 3.1: 'incorporated in June 2025... grown to a team of twelve (12) personnel'.
contradictions_and_investigation_playboo.evidence_b: SOC 2 Report Section 3.1.2: 'Since its incorporation in August 2024, the company has grown to 9 personnel'.
contradictions_and_investigation_playboo.agent_guidance: Flag this discrepancy when asked about headcount or incorporation year. Report that official records present conflicting figures (June 2025 with 12 personnel vs August 2024 with 9 personnel), and request confirmation from HR/Leadership.

contradictions_and_investigation_playboo.description: The standalone SDLC document in infrastructure is an unfilled template, while actual SDLC rules are codified in the Information Security Policy.
contradictions_and_investigation_playboo.evidence_a: Secure Development Lifecycle Document 01.docx: Contains unfilled template placeholders like '<Company Name>', '<Policy owner>', and instructions on how to adopt the template.
contradictions_and_investigation_playboo.evidence_b: Information Security Policy v1.0 (Sec 13): Enforces pull-request peer reviews in GitHub and mandatory production deployment approval by CEO/CTO/CBO.
contradictions_and_investigation_playboo.agent_guidance: Confirm that development controls (peer PR review, branch protection, founder approvals) are active per Information Security Policy, but note that the standalone SDLC document is currently in draft template status.

contradictions_and_investigation_playboo.description: VAPT report identified 20 vulnerabilities (including High CVSS 8.1 Missing Authentication and CVSS 6.5 Prompt Injection), but questionnaire Q66 asks if findings have been remediated.
contradictions_and_investigation_playboo.evidence_a: VAPT Report 01: Discovered 20 distinct vulnerabilities across web applications, open APIs, AI chatbot prompt injection, and excessive token lifetimes.
contradictions_and_investigation_playboo.evidence_b: Vulnerability and Patch Management Policy: Defines remediation SLAs (Critical = 7 days, High = 30 days, Medium = 60 days, Low = 90 days).
contradictions_and_investigation_playboo.agent_guidance: Do NOT blindly claim that all penetration test findings are remediated. State that 20 findings were identified in the latest VAPT report, high/critical items are undergoing remediation within the policy SLA (30 days for High), and mark full remediation status as 'Needs Confirmation / Ongoing'.
